title: Australian healthcare AI startup Heidi raised $340M, including a $100M Series C led by Blackbird at a $900M valuation, taking its total funding to $430M+ (Olivia Poh/Bloomberg)
summary: Olivia Poh / Bloomberg: Australian healthcare AI startup Heidi raised $340M, including a $100M Series C led by Blackbird at a $900M valuation, taking its total funding to $430M+ — Heidi, an artificial intelligence startup which helps doctors automate clinical notes and other administrative work …
